title: Country Climate and Development Report: Georgia
temporal_coverage: Historical hazard impacts and current exposure; scenario-based climate and poverty projections to 2030 and 2050.
methodology: Country assessment combines climate, infrastructure and poverty analysis using household and hazard data.
limitations: Modeled regional estimates may mask within-region variation.

title: A People-Centered Approach to Inclusive Growth, Sustainability and Human Development in Georgia: Country Analysis Summary Report 2025
organization: United Nations Country Team in Georgia
temporal_coverage: Country analysis published in 2025; summarizes current development, climate and conflict vulnerabilities and institutional status.
methodology: Synthesis of official data, UN research and stakeholder workshops in May-June 2025.
limitations: Intersectional framing, not a measured causal pathway.

title: South Caucasus Climate Impact Profile
organization: adelphi research; authored by Sam Geldin (Climatepedia)
temporal_coverage: Observed regional climate and displacement context; near-term 2020-2039 and medium-term 2040-2059 scenarios.
methodology: Regional synthesis of observed climate, projections and sectoral impacts across three countries.
limitations: Not all cross-country findings are Georgia-specific; IDPs are localized broadly.

title: Reducing the Risk of Climate-Driven Disasters in Georgia
organization: United Nations Development Programme and Government of Georgia
temporal_coverage: Ongoing programme listed for December 2018-January 2028; page reports implementation outputs and status as accessed on 2026-10-27.
methodology: UNDP page reports programme implementation outputs and status.
limitations: Self-reported; update date unstated, no independent outcome evaluation.

title: Impacts of Climate Change on Georgia’s Coastal Zone: Vulnerability Assessment and Adaptation Options
temporal_coverage: 2020 coastal vulnerability study; includes observed 2017 degradation estimates and projections based mainly on 2015 climate models.
methodology: Reviews climate projections, coastal risks and sector impacts with expert input, consultations and cost-of-environmental-degradation analysis.
limitations: Regional projections use simplified assumptions; 2017 degradation estimates are not disaggregated by municipality.
